title: Holomorphic Toroidal Pseudodifferential Operators on the Polydisk
summary: We give a necessary and sufficient triangular condition characterizing the toroidal pseudodifferential operators on $\mathbb T^d$ that preserve the positive-frequency cone $\mathbb N_0^d$ and hence act on holomorphic boundary values on the polydisk. For symbols of type $(1,0)$, we prove boundedness on holomorphic Besov and Triebel--Lizorkin spaces throughout the quasi-Banach range. For $S^m_{ρ,δ}$, $0\leqδ<ρ\leq1$, we obtain the critical loss $d(1-ρ)|1/p-1/2|$, together with endpoint estimates.
